verdict.rationale: Fellow documents configurable organization-wide retention policies, including zero-day retention, and a Super Admin API that can retrieve, export, and delete workspace data to meet privacy obligations. For an AI-native user this makes deletion scriptable, and transcript redaction adds data-minimization control. missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring retention (durations, scope, per-user vs admin control), API deletion is limited to Enterprise-plan Super Admins, no documented per-user self-service deletion, no independent or hands-on corroboration.
